Sahrani Counts a total of 41 Towns/Cities. 18 on the northern part of the island, 22 on the southern part of the island and Carazol which is Central.  There are also numerous inabited [[Sahrani Islands list|islands]] and rocky outcrops off the coast of Sahrani.
